Signal Board Watchlist News Learn Methodology

This free tool tracks gold, silver, four gold mining stocks, three ETFs, and two gold-backed cryptoassets. It marks 3–4 consecutive red days as 50% BUY / WATCH and 5 or more as 100% BUY / STRONG. The labels describe rule stages, not probabilities or individualized position sizes.

Buy Signal Rule

HOLD0–2 consecutive red trading days
50% BUY / WATCH3–4 consecutive red trading days
100% BUY / STRONG5 or more consecutive red trading days
Signals are calculated from each asset's daily close. A day counts as "red" when its close is lower than the previous trading day's.
